_comment: Deterministic fixture for the plugin safety harness. Seeds the MLB season-schedule cache (key mlb_schedule_2026) with one final, one in-progress, and one scheduled game so recent/upcoming render real game cards without network access. MLBLiveManager._fetch_data() -> _fetch_todays_games() is a direct network call with no cache read, so the live screen cannot be fed from mock data; instead test_mode (which the baseball adapter passes through to the managers) makes the live manager render its deterministic built-in BOS @ NYY live game with no network access.
